int_name: N 6TH ST & N INDEPENDENCE MALL W

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is characterized by a wide, multi-lane arterial road that lacks marked crosswalks and pedestrian signals. While sidewalks are present on both sides, the long unprotected crossing distance and high-speed roadway design create a hostile environment for people walking.

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross at least four lanes of traffic without a refuge island or marked crossing.

hazards.name: Lack of Crossing Infrastructure
hazards.description: No marked crosswalks or pedestrian signals are visible at this wide intersection point.
hazards.location_in_image: Roadway area in the foreground and mid-ground

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Construct a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the roadway at the crossing point to reduce crossing distance and improve visibility.

result.summary: The environment is a high-speed, multi-lane roadway transition with significant pedestrian-vehicle conflict potential. Despite the presence of sidewalks and traffic signals, there are no marked crosswalks or pedestrian signals visible, creating a hostile environment for walking.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crosswalks
hazards.description: Pedestrians have no designated or protected space to cross this wide, multi-lane roadway at a signalized intersection.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the entire foreground intersection area.

hazards.name: High-speed design
hazards.description: The roadway geometry and signage for major highways (I-676, I-95) suggest high vehicle speeds and a focus on throughput over pedestrian safety.
hazards.location_in_image: Main roadway lanes and overhead signage.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install high-visibility (continental) crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Islands
interventions.description: Install raised refuge islands in the center of the roadway to reduce exposure time and allow for two-stage crossing.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Signalization
interventions.description: Install pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide dedicated crossing phases.

result.summary: The intersection is equipped with high-visibility continental crosswalks, pedestrian signals, and a green-painted bike lane. However, the wide multi-lane roadway creates a significant crossing distance for pedestrians without the protection of a median or refuge island.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic in a single stage without a refuge island.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the intersection across the main roadway

hazards.name: High-Speed Roadway Geometry
hazards.description: The wide, multi-lane configuration and lack of traffic calming measures may encourage higher vehicle speeds.
hazards.location_in_image: Main travel lanes extending into the background

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median or refuge island to reduce exposure time and allow pedestrians to cross the wide street in two stages.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signals to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before vehicles get a green light.

result.summary: The image shows a wide multi-lane arterial road with a high-visibility continental crosswalk. While sidewalks and markings are present, the long unprotected crossing distance and lack of a median refuge island create a high-exposure environment for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross at least four lanes of traffic without a median refuge, increasing exposure time to vehicles.

hazards.name: Multiple Threat Risk
hazards.description: The multi-lane configuration allows for vehicles in one lane to block the view of pedestrians for drivers in adjacent lanes.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the width of the marked crosswalk

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: Visible cracking and wear in the asphalt near the crossing area could present a minor tripping hazard or affect vehicle braking.

interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Signage and Lighting
interventions.description: Add pedestrian crossing warning signs and ensure lighting is optimized specifically for the crosswalk area.
